patch.summary: Turbotic cost guide: researched plan structure, free/trial flags, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.body: Turbotic pricing is plan-gated across 4 researched tiers. Free entry: Free. Trial/free path present in researched plans. Compare seat/capacity gates and unlocks — not list-price folklore.

blocks.heading: Turbotic cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price Turbotic against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Stay on Free until a gated capability (enterprise admin and SSO (Free, Basic, Pro, Enterprise)) becomes mandatory.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (LLM chat and assistants, reasoning / advanced models, writing and paraphrasing) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: Newer platform — confirm enterprise references and connector catalog depth. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.

steps.label: Pay up when Teams that want AI-generated automation code with self-healing execution requires a paid unlock you will use weekly

items.title: Cost trap 1
items.body: Newer platform — confirm enterprise references and connector catalog depth

items.title: Cost trap 2
items.body: Execution/chat quotas vary by tier — monitor usage on Free and Basic

items.title: Cost trap 3
items.body: Not a general-purpose LLM chat replacement like ChatGPT

items.title: Cost trap 4
items.body: Self-host/open-source automation peers (n8n Community) differ on deployment model

items.title: Cost trap 5
items.body: Complex legacy RPA (UiPath-class) is a different job cluster
